items.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 releases on OTT today: Where and when to watch, cast, plot and more
items.sum: Rajinikanth's blockbuster action-crime sequel Jailer 2 is heading for an OTT premiere on Prime Video on November 12. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Sun Pictures, the film has grossed USD 86 million to become the highest-grossing Tamil-language film of all time. Rajinikanth reprises his role as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian alongside a large ensemble cast that includes Mohanlal, Vijay Sethupathi, and Shivarajkumar. Director Nelson Dilipkumar stated, 'The response to Jailer was extraordinary, and the love audiences have shown for Muthuvel Pandian has been one of the most rewarding aspects.' The film originally opened in theatres on October 15.

items.sum: Director Mu Maran's upcoming emotional entertainer 'Appa Kutty', starring Vijay Antony, has already secured a table profit ahead of its November 20 theatrical release. Distributor G Dhananjayan revealed at a pre-release event that all investments were recovered before the premiere, stating, "Whatever he spent on the film, he has recovered more, even before the film's release." The action family drama was shot in just 45 days across two schedules and has received a U/A certificate from the CBFC.

items.sum: Balaji Tharaneetharan directs the Tamil comedy drama Baththa, starring Vijay Sethupathi and Master Sai Prithviraj alongside Lijomol Jose and Santhy Balachandran. The story follows a ruthless gangster who gets trapped inside a school toilet by a terrified little boy named Sabari, who feeds him daily while refusing to open the door out of fear. During his confinement, the gangster undergoes a transformation after reflecting on his life and family. The two-and-a-half-hour film suffers from loose editing and uneven execution despite strong performances from the lead actors and a solid premise.
